correctness.rationale: The reciprocal transforms of both pure-pulse types are exact. All four-window return fixed points solve a quadratic unless the return is locally identity, which cannot produce isolated cycles. Cyclic merging proves at most one isolated cycle in up to three windows. The exact strictly concave defect function gives four count regimes at the stated radicals; derivative signs and nonzero second and parameter derivatives establish stability and fold. Both rational periodic trajectories and their Floquet multipliers were checked by exact arithmetic; 553 assertions passed. Squaring is used only for a necessary upper bound, while the explicit example has a proved converse admissibility criterion. Numerical checks are supplementary, not proof of global facts.

value.rationale: The problem is naturally motivated by the lack of a universal Abel cycle bound and by the 2026 emphasis on coefficient-structure uniqueness. The theorem finds the exact minimal pulse complexity that permits coexistence, a universal sharp bound within the entire four-window family, and a complete attractive/repelling two-cycle bifurcation diagram distinguishing an infinity boundary from a finite fold. It is structural rather than a routine computation of a single chosen periodic orbit.
